title: The gaming PC that costs less than your phone

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: You know that gaming PC you thought was way too expensive? Think again.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Your phone costs more than a fully built gaming rig — and here's why.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This PC runs the latest games at 1080p with a Ryzen 5 7600X and RTX 4060.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s built with 16GB DDR5 RAM and a 512GB NVMe SSD for blazing fast load times.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This changes the game for students, streamers, and budget gamers everywhere.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The takeaway? High performance doesn’t have to mean high prices.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ever considered what you could build for less than your phone?

caption_text: The gaming PC that costs less than your phone
